modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Economy Basic tickets bought on or after January 3, 2025 include only a personal item within Canada, to/from the U.S., Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 standard item up to 23 x 40 x 55 cm / 9 x 15.5 x 21.5 in, wheels and handles included.

personal_item.value: 1 personal item up to 33 x 43 x 16 cm / 13 x 17 x 6 in.

carryon_weight.value: No weight limit applies to carry-on baggage, but it must be light enough to store in the overhead bin without assistance.

basic_fare.value: Economy Basic (tickets bought on or after January 3, 2025): 1 personal item only within Canada and to/from the U.S. (including Hawaii and Puerto Rico), Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean. Other bags must be checked before security.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: How many bags are included depends on your fare and route; Air Canada's baggage calculator shows the allowance for a specific trip.

size_weight.value: Each checked bag up to 158 cm / 62 in (length + width + height, wheels and handles included) and 23 kg / 50 lb. Bags over these limits may incur additional fees.

military.value: Active, retired and reserve Canadian and U.S. military members can check up to three bags, each up to 32 kg (70 lb), at no charge on Air Canada, Air Canada Rouge and Air Canada Express flights.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are Air Canada's standards for its own flights (Air Canada, Rouge and Express). On codeshares, the operating airline is responsible.

care.value: When a delay or cancellation is within Air Canada's control or required for safety, you were told less than 12 hours before departure and you have waited two hours: food and drink, access to a means of communication, and a hotel with transport for out-of-town passengers on overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For a disruption within Air Canada's control, it rebooks you on the next available Air Canada or partner flight within 9 hours of the original departure (within 48 hours when the cause is outside its control). If no option suits you and the flight is cancelled or disrupted by three hours or more, it refunds the unused portion of your ticket.

compensation.value: For a delay or cancellation within Air Canada's control that gets you to your destination three hours or more late: $400 CAD (3 to 6 hours), $700 CAD (6 to 9 hours) or $1,000 CAD (9 hours or more), unless you were told 15 days before departure.

phone_home_market.notes: Air Canada official customer support line.

fare_name.value: Basic Economy: includes 1 carry-on bag up to 10 kg and 1 personal item; checked bag incurs a fee; non-refundable

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat selection during online check-in 24 hours before departure; advance seat assignment prior to check-in requires a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Non-changeable and non-refundable unless permitted by fare rules or statutory passenger protection regulations

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Signature Class (1-2-1 executive lie-flat suites), Premium Economy (2-3-2 38" pitch), and Economy (3-3-3 / 3-3 30-31" pitch)

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance online or via app (included in Latitude/Flex/Premium/Business; fee for Basic/Standard), or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Air Canada automatically assigns adjacent seats for children under 14 and an accompanying parent/guardian free of charge before check-in
